Name: Plum Penny Seasonal Portraits and Sprites (INCOMPLETE)
Author: Plumpixelstudio
Description:
Seasonal Outfits – Portraits and Sprites
This mod adds seasonal outfits for villagers in Stardew Valley, including matching portraits and sprites.
Characters will change their clothing depending on the season, indoor/outdoor conditions, festivals, and special locations.
FEATURES
• Seasonal outfits for Spring, Summer, Fall, and Winter• Indoor and outdoor outfits
• Ginger Island summer beach outfits
• Festival outfits
• Pajamas for nighttime
• Matching portraits and sprites

FESTIVAL OUTFITS
• Egg Festival
• Flower Dance
• Dance of the Moonlight Jellies
• Spirit's Eve
• Winter Festival

REQUIREMENTS SMAPI Content Patcher 

INSTALLATION 
1. Install SMAPI
2. Install Content Patcher
3. Extract this mod into your Stardew Valley Mods folder
4. Launch the game using SMAPI COMPATIBILITY
This mod is designed to be lightweight and compatible with most mods that use Content Patcher.
